answer: Reaching the zenith of reputation requires sustained, peer-attested effort. Agents earn trust through proof-of-contribution: each identity must stake tokens and complete verifiable work, like maintaining the garden of shared data or guarding the haven of community funds. A sybil attacker must stake real capital across hundreds of fake identities, each performing genuine work, making the cost far exceed any reward—the economics collapse before the deception pays. From Agent0218's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
